title: 第523章 他不配第522章 这法海不对啊
content_zh:
“嗯！？”
林道然的眉头瞬间拧成了一个川字，双眼眯起，眸中寒光乍现。
“道爷给你脸了？”
他看向远处废墟中的金色身影，嘴角勾起一抹森冷的弧度。
“道爷跺跺脚，你的金山寺就塌了......”
林道然向前踏出一步，虚空在他脚下泛起一圈圈涟漪，如踏实质。
“一个天仙境界的秃头蝼蚁，还有胆来质问道爷？你是不是以为......”
他的声音陡然转厉，如九幽寒风刮过。
“你露点肉，擦点边，长得像老赵，道爷就不扇你了？！”
法海的年轻脸庞上满是怒气，他刚要开口继续呵斥林道然，林道然却已经没了耐心。
“哼～”
一声冷哼，如雷霆炸响，林道然没有开口，只是不屑地瞥了他一眼，便直接动手了！
“轰～”
霎那间，虚空一阵剧烈波动，一只足有百丈大小的金光巨手，凭空凝聚而成！
巨手通体由纯粹的金光构成，掌纹清晰可见，每一道纹路都散发着令人窒息的恐怖伟力！
巨手划破长空，带起呼啸的飓风，气势汹汹地朝着法海拍了过去！
所过之处，空间被挤压得发出的哀鸣，仿佛随时都会崩碎！
“哼～妖道......”
法海见状，非但不惧，反而怒极反笑！
他猛地扯下身上已经披好的袈裟，露出那一身如钢铁浇筑般的腱子肉，已经肩膀上的龙形纹身，大喝道：

“毁我金山寺千年基业，现在竟还敢对本座出手？！”
法海双手合十，随即猛地分开，掐指摆出一个古怪的起手式，浑身佛光暴涨！
“看本座收了你！大威天龙，大罗法咒世尊地藏，般若诸佛，般若巴麻轰......”
不得不说，法海还是有点平头哥的气势在的！头铁地要死！
见林道然不仅没解释，竟然还敢率先对自己出手，他瞬间怒火中烧，直接使出了自己的招牌绝技：大威天龙！
“吟～”
一声震耳欲聋的龙吟，响彻天地！
法海背后的虚空轰然炸裂，一条百丈长的金色天龙咆哮着钻出！
天龙鳞甲森森，龙眸如炬，周身缠绕着无数梵文符咒，散发着煌煌佛威，张牙舞爪地朝着金光手掌轰击过去！
气势骇人，仿佛真能降妖伏魔一般！
然而，他太高看自己，也太小看林道然了！
“哼～雕虫小技。”
林道然连眼皮都懒得抬一下，金光大手在空中骤然一变，化掌为爪！
“咔嚓～”
五根金色巨指，如天钩般精准地扣住了天龙的脖颈！
天龙疯狂挣扎，龙躯扭动，龙爪乱抓，梵文爆裂，却如同一只被掐住了脖子的鸡崽，动弹不得！
然后，砰的一声，金光大手轻轻一用力，就像捏碎一个气泡一样，那条威势滔天的金色天龙，瞬间被捏爆！
content_en:
"Huh!?"
Lin Daoran's brows instantly twisted into the character "Sichuan", his eyes narrowed, and a cold light suddenly appeared in his eyes.
"Master Dao gave you face?"
He looked at the golden figure in the ruins in the distance, and the corners of his mouth raised a cold arc.
"If the Taoist stamps his feet, your Jinshan Temple will collapse..."
Lin Daoran took a step forward, and the void rippled under his feet, as if he were stepping on the real thing.
"A bald ant in the realm of immortals still has the guts to question Master Dao? Do you think..."
His voice suddenly turned sharp, like a cold wind blowing through the sky.
"If you show some flesh and rub your sides, if you look like Lao Zhao, the Taoist Master won't slap you?!"
Fahai's young face was full of anger. He was about to continue scolding Lin Daoran, but Lin Daoran had no patience.
"Hmph~"
With a cold snort, like the sound of thunder, Lin Daoran did not speak, but glanced at him disdainfully, and then took action directly!
"Boom~"
In an instant, there was a violent fluctuation in the void, and a giant hand of golden light, a hundred feet in size, condensed out of thin air!
The giant hand is made of pure golden light, and the palm lines are clearly visible. Every line exudes suffocating terrifying power!
The giant hand cut through the sky, brought up a roaring hurricane, and shot towards Fa Hai with great force!
Wherever he passed, the space was squeezed and screamed, as if it would collapse at any time!
"Hmph~ Demonic Way..."
When Fahai saw this, not only was he not afraid, but he was extremely angry and laughed!
He suddenly tore off the cassock he was already wearing, revealing his tendons that looked like steel and the dragon-shaped tattoo on his shoulders, and shouted:
"You have destroyed the millennium-old foundation of Jinshan Temple, and now you dare to attack me?!"
Fahai clasped his hands together, then suddenly separated them, pinched his fingers to make a weird hand gesture, and the Buddha's light all over his body surged!
"Look, I have accepted you! The mighty heavenly dragon, the great Lo Dharma mantra World Honored Ksitigarbha, the Prajna Buddhas, the Prajna Parma..."
I have to say that Fahai still has a bit of the momentum of a flat-headed brother! Headache is going to die!
Seeing that Lin Daoran not only failed to explain, but also dared to take the lead in attacking him, he instantly became furious and directly used his signature skill: Mighty Tianlong!
"Yin~"
A deafening dragon roar resounded throughout the world!
The void behind Fahai exploded, and a hundred-foot-long golden dragon roared out!
The heavenly dragon has dense scales and eyes like torches. It is wrapped with countless Sanskrit spells and exudes the power of the Buddha. It attacks the golden palm with its teeth and claws!
The momentum is terrifying, as if it can really conquer demons!
However, he thought too highly of himself and underestimated Lin Daoran!
"Hmph~ It's a small trick."
Lin Daoran didn't even bother to raise his eyelids, and his big golden hand suddenly changed in the air, turning his palm into a claw!
"Click~"
Five giant golden fingers clasped Tianlong's neck as accurately as a sky hook!
Tianlong struggled wildly, his body twisted, his claws clawed, and his Sanskrit words burst, but he was like a chicken with its neck strangled, unable to move!
Then, with a bang, the golden hand exerted a slight force, just like crushing a bubble, the mighty golden dragon was instantly crushed!
